A center-of-mass energy of W = 1.2 GeV is far below threshold, meaning there is insufficient energy to produce an eta meson in the final state. Furthermore, the EtaMAID-2023 model table only covers W = 1.4856-6.0 GeV, so W = 1.2 GeV is outside the interpolation range. The code's interpolation routine (interp, exclurad.F:4003) would detect out-of-range values and return zero multipoles, producing a meaningless result. A valid eta electroproduction computation requires W >= 1.486 GeV. If the user intended a different process or made a typo in W, please provide corrected kinematics.
